description: Implement exponential backoff and retry for the GitHub API client defined in T-005. On RateLimitError: wait until x-ratelimit-reset timestamp. On SecondaryRateLimitError (403 + retry-after header): wait the specified duration. On 5xx: exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 retries. On AuthError or NotFoundError: do not retry, fail immediately. Wrap the paginate() helper so retries are transparent to callers.
title: GitHub API retry/backoff implementation
